Prevention: Maintain proper plant spacing (45 x 30 cm)
Monitoring: Observe for white powdery growth mostly on the lower surface of the leaves during dry humid climate
Observe for the yellow patches on the upper surface
Observe for shedding (leaf fall) of severely infected leaves and fruits
Restrictions: Use of personal protective equipment (PPEs) such as gloves, mask, goggles and keeping antidotes are mandatory by the spray applicators.
Wettable sulphur @ 0.3%, at disease initiation stage and repeat once at weekly interval.
